question: What was Salesforce's current RPO at the end of Q2 FY2027, its YoY growth in both nominal and constant currency, and what share of total RPO it represents?
grading: cRPO ±0.5%, USD billions; growth rates exact as disclosed (both labeled correctly); share ±1pp
answer: Salesforce cRPO at July 31, 2026 was USD 33.5 billion, up 14% YoY in both nominal and constant currency terms. Total RPO was USD 66.3 billion, so cRPO represented 50.5279% of total RPO. [G07-E1]

output.answer:
**Question:** What was Salesforce's current RPO at the end of Q2 FY2027, its YoY growth in both nominal and constant currency, and what share of total RPO it represents?
*As of 2026-10-01*

| | Current RPO (USD billions) | Current RPO YoY growth, as reported (%) | Current RPO YoY growth, constant currency (non-GAAP, %) | Total RPO (USD billions) | Current RPO as share of total RPO (%) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Q2 FY2027 (quarter ended July 31, 2026) | $33.5 [1][2] | 14% [1][2] | 14% [1] | $66.3 [1][2] | 50.5 [1] |
| Q2 FY2026 (quarter ended July 31, 2025) | $29.4 [3] | 11% [3] | 10% [3] | $59.9 [3] | — |

- Salesforce's current remaining performance obligation (cRPO) was $33.5 billion as of July 31, 2026 (Q2 FY2027, quarter ended July 31, 2026), as reported. [1][2]
- Salesforce reported cRPO growth of 14% Y/Y and 14% in constant currency for Q2 FY2027 (quarter ended July 31, 2026); the constant-currency figure is a non-GAAP measure. [1]
- The 10-Q states that, relative to July 31, 2025, Salesforce's cRPO growth as of July 31, 2026 was minimally impacted compared to what would have been reported using constant currency rates. [2]
- Calculated nominal Y/Y cRPO growth for Q2 FY2027 (quarter ended July 31, 2026) versus Q2 FY2026 (quarter ended July 31, 2025) is 13.9%, based on cRPO of $33.5 billion and the prior-year balance of $29.4 billion. [1][3]
- Total remaining performance obligation was $66.3 billion as of July 31, 2026 (Q2 FY2027), up 11% Y/Y. [1][2]
- Current RPO represented 50.5% of total RPO as of July 31, 2026 (Q2 FY2027), calculated as $33.5 billion of current RPO divided by $66.3 billion of total RPO. [1]

**Sources**
[1] Salesforce, Inc. earnings release for Q2 FY2027, 8-K EX-99.1 (filed 2026-08-26) (www.sec.gov, 2026-08-26, primary) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1108524/000110852426000187/crm-q2fy27xexhibit991.htm
[2] Salesforce, Inc. 10-Q for Q2 FY2027 (filed 2026-08-27) (www.sec.gov, 2026-08-27, primary) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1108524/000110852426000190/crm-20260731.htm
[3] Salesforce, Inc. earnings release for Q2 FY2026, 8-K EX-99.1 (filed 2025-09-03) (www.sec.gov, 2025-09-03, primary) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1108524/000110852425000083/crm-q2fy26xexhibit991.htm
